subject: Follow-up on your stalled MetaDefender Sandbox queue
body:
Hi Hannah,

Thanks for your time today. Here is a quick recap.

What we found: your analysis queue is stalled because the data drive is about 96 percent full, and the Sandbox log reports not enough free disk space to start a new analysis. Old analysis reports and unused VM images are the likely cause.

Next steps:
1. You: send a breakdown of folder sizes on the data drive today.
2. Me: send the documented cleanup steps and confirm what is safe to remove.
3. Me: tell you what to check once the queue starts moving again.

Please don't delete anything by hand until you have my steps.

More background on managing disk usage: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/sandbox/administration/disk-usage-retention

claims_needing_verification.claim: Old analysis reports and unused VM images use most of the space on the data drive.
claims_needing_verification.reason: The folder size breakdown has not been received yet.
